body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Lisbon, Portugal. It starts at Av. Eusébio da Silva Ferreira.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Explore Estádio da Luz on a self-guided tour and experience Portuguese football.
>
> The tour has various stops, with a knowledgeable guide at each stop. They'll tell you everything you need to know about the stadium.
>
> Start your tour at Door 17, then stroll along the pitch. Take a peek into the locker rooms and drop by the press conference room. Finally, snap your picture below the eagles at Estádio da Luz.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €30.36. It was rated 4.6 out of 5 from 142 ratings and 62 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
